Weak ward posts put field workers and crops at risk. Ignoring local directions wastes time. A channel coughs up cold light instead of water. A farmer stops mid-sentence to listen to a post go silent. The Keystone pulses toward Open Vale. Let the place be funny through overconfident signage, awkward forms, stubborn local habits, and magic that refuses corporate language.
